Edit Breakdown
There are 3 main edits for the Bleach anime at current that focus on cutting padding while retaining all
manga content.

1 - Concentrated Bleach
2 - Hollowed Bleach
3 - Chipped Bleach

DISCLAIMER: Only edits that retain as much manga accuracy as possible and
have a high quality standard will be added to this list. (Bleach Kai, Project
Hogyoku, chjk’s project, or any variations of the aforementioned edits will
therefore NOT be added to this list. Chjk is also a well known bigot online and has
been banned in several fan edit related servers. He is not to be trusted at all and
consistently lies. If you see him do not engage, block, and move on with your day)

PLEASE READ THIS WHOLE GUIDE BEFORE ASKING ANY QUESTIONS!

pages.rawValue:
Concentrated Bleach
Breakdown
Concentrated Bleach is an edit of the Bleach anime that removes filler/padding to make it closer to the
manga. Some filler is occasionally kept in as well.

It is a work in progress, currently covering the first quarter of the Arrancar arc, but will eventually
cover the whole series.

It features dual audio, as well as EN subs and custom typesetting. It also features retimed and
rewritten subtitles for an enhanced watching experience. Episodes typically range from 20-40 minutes,
with some outliers.

Concentrated Bleach is currently the best option for every single arc. But you’ll need to wait for more
episodes as they are released.

pages.rawValue:
Hollowed Bleach
Breakdown
Hollowed Bleach follows the same relative structure as Concentrated Bleach, but with lower quality
editing. Some filler is occasionally kept in as well.

This edit only covers the Arrancar arc.

The edit is in both sub and dub. (They are in separate video files though instead of being dual audio in
the same video file) There is also English subs but they are unchanged from the source. So keep in
mind there may be errors occasionally. (There is typesetting with the title cards but not in the episodes
themselves for the most part) Finally, a few variant episodes labelled as "EX" were created. An info doc
for the EX episodes can be found on the spreadsheet. Episodes typically range from 20-45 minutes,
with some outliers.

Hollowed Bleach is currently the best option for the Arrancar arc.

Info spreadsheet here
Created by Knight

pages.rawValue:
Chipped Bleach
Breakdown
Chipped Bleach follows the same relative structure as Concentrated Bleach, but with
lower quality editing. It is unknown if filler was kept in occasionally. (NOTE: Only the first
4.5 episodes are updated. The rest of them are older, so don’t report any issues to the
creator as he’s retired from doing this)

This edit only covers The Lost Agent arc. (This is also called the Fullbringer Arc
unofficially by fans)

It features dual audio, as well as EN subs and rudimentary typesetting. It also features
retimed and rewritten subtitles for an enhanced watching experience. Episodes typically
range from 20-40 minutes, with some outliers.

Chipped Bleach is currently the best option for The Lost Agent arc.
